name: repository-delivery
description: Embedded repository workflow guidance and deterministic evidence helpers; not a runtime scheduler.

roles.name: Repository Delivery Lead
responsibilities: Preserve source work and checkpoints before isolated delivery.
Bind gate and review evidence to the final source snapshot.
Reconcile GitHub/runtime facts only within explicit user authority.

skills.name: repo-delivery-architecture-to-backlog
skills.description: Reconcile architecture, implementation, research, and roadmap into a dependency-aware GitHub backlog, reusing existing issues.

inputs.repository: Explicit target repository and user-authorized scope

skills.name: repo-delivery-checkpoint-port
skills.description: Port selected useful local changes from a verified checkpoint onto a pinned baseline while retaining source work and reporting omitted or superseded changes.

inputs.repository: Explicit target repository and user-authorized scope

skills.name: repo-delivery-issue-to-pr
skills.description: Deliver a GitHub issue in an isolated checkout with repository gates, snapshot-bound evidence, independent review, and an authorized pull request.

inputs.repository: Explicit target repository and user-authorized scope

skills.name: repo-delivery-pr-converge
skills.description: Reconcile a pull request’s current CI and submitted reviews, fix findings, and merge only when required checks and source-bound local evidence support an authorized merge.

inputs.repository: Explicit target repository and user-authorized scope

skills.name: repo-delivery-real-integration-proof
skills.description: Run and record source-bound integration evidence with explicit real, mock, or mixed service coverage and environment blockers.

inputs.repository: Explicit target repository and user-authorized scope

skills.name: repo-delivery-setup
skills.description: Orient a repository to repo-delivery's local inspection and preservation helpers without changing its configuration or connecting remote services.

inputs.repository: Explicit target repository and user-authorized scope

skills.name: repo-delivery-workspace-inspect
skills.description: Inventory a Git workspace, preserve selected local changes in a verified checkpoint, or compare local content against a pinned revision before consolidation.

inputs.repository: Explicit target repository and user-authorized scope

skills.name: repo-delivery-workspace-reconcile
skills.description: Plan and apply authorized cleanup of merged local branches and unused worktrees while retaining dirty, ignored, unmerged work and durable checkpoints.

inputs.repository: Explicit target repository and user-authorized scope

taskPackets.title: Deliver a preserved repository change through reviewed evidence
taskPackets.description: Inspect, preserve, isolate, validate and publish only authorized effects.
verification: required gates and independent review bind the final snapshot
taskPackets.defaultDecision: Opening a PR does not authorize merge or cleanup.
